questions.stem: A 38-year-old woman presented with pain in her hands for the past year. She takes acetaminophen with some relief. The pain began in several metacarpophalangeal joints of the hands. Pain has started in the feet as well, affecting the metatarsophalangeal joints. She has difficulty moving the joints when getting out of bed or after staying in one position too long. The pain is worse in the morning, but improves as she starts to move around over the course of the day over the next 1 to 2 hours. Reports: ESR: 68 mm/h, CRP: elevated, Anti-CCP: positive, Chest x-ray: effusion on right side. What is the most likely diagnosis
